notes.title: Release Preview 2.0.1
notes.notes:
Hello, everyone, 

We are working hard to give you the best possible experience in Improbable Soccer.
This update fixes a couple of issues found in the last update.

Here is the changelog:

 Added new songs to menu playlist by NoCopyrightSounds
 Fixed the problem related to audio settings at the beginning of the game
 Fixed several issues related to achievements that were not being unlocked correctly
 Fixed some translations related to the music player 
 Fixed an issue that did not allow reselecting buttons in the menu when opening a bug report


We look forward to seeing you on our discord server to exchange opinions and feedback on this new version of the game.


Thank you all as always for your support!

- CyberLab Studios

notes.title: Improbable Soccer 2.0 Release Preview
notes.notes:
Hello Improbable players!

We are ready to show you the work we made in the last few years to give you the full release that this game deserves.

This is a preview build and is feature complete. There are still some details (especially sound) missing that we will work on in this final period before the final release.  

We want to thank all the people who volunteered to test the game and report bugs during the playtest phase that we launched in June 2024.

Here's the changelog:

 Reprogrammed the entire game to improve the user experience and fix all the bugs that the first version of the game had.
 Redesigned the entire user interface to improve the use of the game especially from controller.
 Menus are now fully navigable from controller and keyboard (mouse no longer required)
 4 new soccer stadiums: Sector GN0P, Oasi Stadium, Domus Aurea, Artic Wind Stadium
 Player customization in the lobby before the start of the game
 27 new achievements
 AI improvements
 WIP translations of the game in 12 different languages: Italian, French, German, Spanish, Portoguese, Portoguese (Brasil), Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Turkish, Polish, Russian


We look forward to seeing you on our discord server to exchange opinions and feedback on this new version of the game.


Thank you all for your support over the years. 
We hope you enjoy the work we have done. 

See you on the Improbable fields!

- CyberLab Studios
